nom: I Dew Care Dew Not Disturb Hydrating Korean Rice Sleeping Mask

avis.texte: I have year round dry skin so I'm always looking for skincare that can help my skin stay moisturized. I ended up buying this mask on a whim, and I'm very happy with it! It has a lovely light scent to it, and I always wake up with my skin feeling moist and smooth (I get the worst rough patches on my cheeks and I've noticed they've gradually gotten softer!). I'm quite impressed with this brand and can't wait to try their other sleep masks and products!

If you're looking for a fun mask in a cute package to use occasionally for self-care, you might love this. If you're someone who really struggles with dry skin and is looking for solutions, this isn't it. I wore the mask overnight, as instructed. When I woke up, my skin was slightly more moisturized. Emphasis on the word slightly. I have used other, more expensive, moisturizing masks that work far better. For the price range, this one does a decent job. However, it's not the holy grail product that the paid reviewers are making it out to be. Great for those who are new to skin care or like to do masks just for fun.
I really like the masks from I Dew. I have purchased a few of them now nc I love tje way my skin looks and feels after I use them. I can see a difference in my complexion and my skin feels smoother.

I bought their hot as sheet masks and this sleeping mask. I thought this could be used as a day moisturizer, but it is definitely kind of sticky and stays wet for a while. It feels cool and no stinging sensation. It's a great night mask.

I received this overnight mask complimentary from I Dew Care. I think that this is a really great, affordable overnight mask that gets the job done. It feels kinda lightweight but really moisturizes my skin. I have combo skin so some patches of my face are a bit dry and this completely evens out my skin. I only use it once a week and have noticed good results. Not to mention the container itself is super cute!

This overnight hydrating mask has more of a watery consistency unlike other thicker masks I've tried. It absorbed quickly and it had a refreshing cooling effect, that helped calm any immediate dryness and itchiness on my face. I woke up with my face feeling plump and moisturized. The glow in the dark packaging is also a nice touch! For the price point, the quality can't be beat. Received complimentary from I Dew Care.

. I've been loving the I Dew Care Dew Not Disturb Hydrating Overnight Mask! The texture is so silky and lightweight, it melts right into my skin without feeling heavy. I wake up with my face feeling plump, soft, and super refreshed—almost like I had a mini facial while I slept. The calming scent makes it extra relaxing for my nighttime routine, and it's become my go-to when my skin feels a little dry or tired.

I used the Dew Not Disturb sleeping mask and woke up with noticeably softer, plumper skin. It feels super lightweight going on, and by morning, my face looked refreshed and deeply hydrated—no tightness or dryness at all. My skin even had a subtle dewy glow, just like it promised. If you're dealing with dryness or dullness, this mask really helps lock in moisture overnight without feeling heavy. Complimentary from idewcare

I really enjoyed using this mask. Everything it was so good, the coloring was very shimmery and unique, which made it very fun to use the product. After using it at night, your skin feels so hydrated and looks very glowy. I'm so glad this as gifted by Idewcare.

This mask really helps with skin that is prone to being dull, dry or tired looking. It is probably my favorite I Dew Care mask and I would definitely recommend to those who struggle with the concerns I listed above.

Complimentary from IDewCare. The moisturizer absorbs quickly into the skin and a little goes a long way. There's no tacky or white residue. There's a slight clean fresh scent but nothing strong. Scent does fade away. My skin looks more glowy and healthier. I have combo skin, but lately my skin has been dry. This moisturizer has changed my skin appearance and texture. My skin feels smoother and looks more healthier.

The I DEW CARE "Wake Up to Dewy Skin" (Dew Not Disturb) Sleeping Mask is a lightweight, jelly-cream overnight treatment designed to deeply hydrate and leave skin plump and glowing by morning. It absorbs quickly without feeling heavy, making it comfortable for overnight wear, and is marketed with bold claims of up to 100 hours of hydration. Users report smoother, healthier-looking, and firmer skin after use, though results may vary depending on skin type. Complementary product gifted by @idewcare.

What stands out the most for me is the result upon waking up: my skin feels soft, plumper, and more hydrated, with zero greasy feeling.

To use, apply a generous layer to clean, dry skin before bedtime and allow it to work overnight. In the morning, rinse your face with water to remove any residue.

Definitely another favorite for my nighttime routine.

Complimentary from idewcare ! This I Dew Care overnight mask is so hydrating in the skin and feels amazing I love the color it has and the packaging goes so well with the product such a good package! Such a fun way to feel refreshed and hydrating the next day!

I didn't find that the jar or letters glow in the dark, but I really enjoyed the cream inside. Perfect for the hotter months when my skin can't handle creams that are too heavy. Gifted by l Dew Care.

This overnight mask is very light/has a jelly like texture and has a faint aloe smell. The glow in the dark jar is also so cute. As a note of caution, I would not keep this product open too long— from past experience, it tends to dry up after long periods of no use. Gifted by idewcare.
